edits.rationale: Boardwalks are wooden paths; they need not be bridges across gaps.

editor_notes: All160 keys read against source. Maze/Sandbars error and title references aligned with edited generator names. Cul-de-sac explicitly has no through route, not merely an end. Terrace describes raised flat ground. Clay is udongo wa mfinyanzi (mfinyanzi alone means potter); boardwalks are wooden paths rather than necessarily bridges. Tower projectile verb made explicit. Material terminology normalized separately after full pass. Portage Lakes retained as descriptive Maziwa ya vivuko with shoreline paths, no invented boat mechanic.

Source-checked material inventory terminology sweep: Malighafi for harvested/stocked/delivered material, distinct from genuine equipment/vifaa; noun-class concord corrected with each change. No target-only blanket replacement.

Final editorial self-check: family plural noun-class zi-/hizi, and closed-ended maze passages expressed as njia zenye mwisho uliofungwa; original independent reviewer must recheck these substantive edits.
certification: Agent edited; not native-human-certified; rendering/platform gates separate
